title: Unbounded Cut Overhead
citation: Peng et al. Phys. Rev. Lett. 125, 150504 (2020)
mitigation: Constrain bisection cut width to k <= 2 or employ wire cutting with mid-circuit reset.

title: Layout-Inflation / SWAP Storm
headline_condition: Transpiled 2Q depth >= 2.0x original on sparse heavy-hex
mitigation: Apply SABRE bidirectional layout optimization and initial physical qubit placement.

title: Unmitigated Readout Bias
mitigation: Apply M3 matrix-free measurement mitigation or T-REX twirled readout error extinguishing.

title: Fridge-Roundtrip Deadlock
headline_condition: Mid-circuit dynamic feedforward latency exceeds T2* dephasing envelope
citation: Salathe et al. Phys. Rev. Applied 9, 034011 (2018)
mitigation: Deploy cryogenic 4K FPGA controllers or replace feedforwards with deferred measurement.

title: Decoder Budget Blowout
headline_condition: Cycle latency exceeds 1000 ns reaction budget (roadmap advisory: not exploitable pre-2029)
citation: Fowler et al. Phys. Rev. A 86, 032324 (2012)
mitigation: Migrate to fast decoders (Union-Find, AFS, QECOOL, NISQ+) at the 4K stage.

title: Vanishing-Gradient Ansatz
headline_condition: Parameterized 2Q layers present with global measurement observable
mitigation: Evaluate local few-body Pauli observables (Cerezo et al. 2021) or identity block initialization.

title: Idle Qubits During Long Gates
headline_condition: Spectator qubits idle for > 30% of total circuit execution duration
citation: Murali et al. ASPLOS 2019; Strikis et al. npj Quantum Inf 7, 142 (2021)
mitigation: Insert XY4 or CPMG dynamical decoupling pulse sequences in spectator idle gaps.

title: Depth Exceeds Coherence Envelope
headline_condition: Estimated execution duration exceeds physical T2* dephasing threshold (50 us)
citation: Krantz et al. Appl. Phys. Rev. 6, 021318 (2019)
mitigation: Compress gate depth with KAK pulse synthesis or target long-coherence trapped-ion hardware.
